front.intro: The back of this East End bungalow is where the work shows: a huge covered garage and a covered patio sit side by side in the fenced yard. String lights are already up over the patio. There's room to park a car and still work in the garage, or to set up for a crowd on the patio. Board and batten covers the front gable over the stoop. Mature trees shade the front yard. The patio is open on the yard side, so you can see the whole yard from it.
front.outro: Some of Houston's premier restaurants are just moments away. The neighborhood has a central community park with walking paths. Pet-friendly amenities and guest parking come with it. The house sits in Rice Military, on the Washington Corridor. Living space sits a level above the street, where the kitchen and dining area share the floor. Each floor is its own level, linked by one stair. The area sits just west of Downtown Houston.

back.title: Covered Space Beyond the Back Door

photos.name: The Front
photos.text: Low shrubs line the front beds, under the two front windows. A stained wood door sits under the covered stoop. Three steps in a blue-gray finish climb to the stoop. The front lawn is green and even.

photos.name: Covered Patio and Garage
photos.text: The covered garage (14'4" x 24'3") sits beside an 8'11" x 25'11" covered patio. Wood posts carry a solid roof over a concrete floor. Windows on the back of the house look out over both spaces.

photos.name: Backyard Deck
photos.text: White steps lead down from the deck to the yard. One mature tree shades the back corner. The deck extends along the back wall of the house. The yard is open ground, ready for a lawn or a garden.

back.headline: A new roof. Hardi Plank siding. Never flooded.
back.para: The laundry's inside the house, and the driveway out front is brand new. The foundation was reworked, leveled and braced before anything else went in. New paint and new lighting carry through the front rooms, and the Kitchen has tons of countertop space. The Primary Bath has a double-sink vanity, an LED mirror and a walk-in shower. The Breakfast Nook opens to the backyard. It's minutes from Downtown and EaDo.

top.title: From the Front Door to the Back Deck
top.planNote: Approximate; not to scale. The buyer verifies every room size.

leads.name: Living Room
leads.text: A wide cased opening joins the Living Room to the Dining area and the Kitchen. A clerestory window high on the wall brings in natural light and keeps the street out of view. Wood-look floors extend from the front door to the Kitchen with no thresholds. A big window on the front wall faces the yard. Light walls and pale floors keep the room bright.

leads.name: Kitchen
leads.text: The Kitchen is laid out in an L around a peninsula. Marble-look counters extend up the wall as the backsplash. A stainless range sits under a chimney hood, and the sink is under the window. The peninsula closes off the cooking side from the Dining area. The L puts the range, the sink and the peninsula within a few steps of each other.

smalls.name: Front Entry
smalls.text: The paneled front door opens straight into the Living Room. Three small windows run across the top of the door. The Dining area is only a few steps farther in.

smalls.name: Breakfast Bar
smalls.text: Two pendant lights hang over the peninsula, with room for barstools. The Dining area (11'2" x 8'9") sits between the peninsula and the hall to the bedrooms.

smalls.name: Breakfast Nook
smalls.text: The nook measures 8'1" x 8'9". Windows fill two of its walls with natural light. A beam crosses the ceiling over it. The Kitchen sits just beside it. The nook's back window looks out over the fence line.

smalls.name: Linen Shelves
smalls.text: Open shelves stand just outside the hall bath. They run from the floor up toward the ceiling. Towels and spare linens have a place outside the bath. The shelves are deep enough for stacked towels.

floors.text: The Living Room, Dining area, Kitchen and nook make up the front half of the house. All of it is on one level, so there are no steps inside. The front rooms sit on the street side of the house. A hall leads off to the bedrooms.
The bedrooms and baths sit down the hall from the front rooms. All the bedrooms share one side of the house. The Primary has its own bath at the back corner.
Both covered spaces sit behind the house and share the fenced yard. You reach them from the deck. The garage runs about 24 feet deep. The patio is nearly 26 feet long.
The roof patio is up the last flight of stairs. A door at the top opens onto the roof. A low wall rings the patio.

bottom.title: A Primary at the Back, Two More Bedrooms

items.name: Primary Bedroom
items.text: The Primary sits at the back of the house, away from the street. A vaulted ceiling carries an exposed painted beam. Windows on two walls pull in natural light. The double-door closet shares a wall with the doorway to the bath. The room is about 14 feet square.

items.name: Primary Bath
items.text: A dark navy vanity holds double sinks under an LED backlit mirror. The counter is marble-look, with a matching backsplash. A rain showerhead and a handheld give two ways to rinse. A small window over the vanity lets in daylight. A towel ring hangs beside the mirror.

items.name: Hall Bath
items.text: Bedrooms 2 and 3 share this bath. The tub has full-height marble-look tile around it. A pebble tile niche holds soap and shampoo. The floor is the same marble-look tile as the walls. A white sink basin sits on the vanity. The tub runs along the back wall, under the window.

items.name: Primary Closet
items.text: Double doors open to a shelving tower with hanging rods on both sides. Shelves above hold bins or luggage. The built-ins are white, to match the walls. A shelf extends along the back wall.

items.name: Bedroom 2
items.text: The larger of the two secondary bedrooms sits at the front corner of the house. Windows bring in daylight from the corner. The room runs about 13 feet each way. Two windows sit side by side on the far wall.

items.name: Bedroom 3
items.text: The closet sits on the hall side, which leaves the window wall open for a desk. The hall bath is only a few steps away. One window on the far wall faces the yard. The door to the hall sits next to the closet.

a.text: Come see the East End bungalow with the covered garage and the covered patio side by side out back. Inside, a wide cased opening joins the Living Room, the Dining area and the L-shaped Kitchen. The Primary is at the back, under a vaulted ceiling.
